author: cairn
blurb: Look up public GitHub repos, issues, and users via the REST API. No key needed for public data.

definition.name: GitHub (public)
definition.description: Read public GitHub data — repositories, issues, and user profiles — via the unauthenticated REST API.

operations.name: get_repo
operations.description: Get metadata for a public repository (stars, description, language, topics, default branch).
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_repo","description":"Get metadata for a public GitHub repository.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"owner":{"type":"string","description":"Repository owner or org, e.g. 'facebook'"},"repo":{"type":"string","description":"Repository name, e.g. 'react'"}},"required":["owner","repo"]}}

operations.name: list_repo_issues
operations.description: List open issues for a public repository (newest first).
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"list_repo_issues","description":"List issues for a public GitHub repository.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"owner":{"type":"string","description":"Repository owner or org"},"repo":{"type":"string","description":"Repository name"},"state":{"type":"string","enum":["open","closed","all"],"description":"Issue state"},"per_page":{"type":"number","description":"Results per page (max 100)"}},"required":["owner","repo"]}}

operations.name: search_repos
operations.description: Search public repositories by keyword, sorted by stars.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_repos","description":"Search public GitHub repositories.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"q":{"type":"string","description":"Search query, e.g. 'language:rust cli'"},"per_page":{"type":"number","description":"Results per page (max 100)"}},"required":["q"]}}

operations.name: get_user
operations.description: Get a public GitHub user or organization profile.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_user","description":"Get a public GitHub user or org profile.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"username":{"type":"string","description":"GitHub login, e.g. 'torvalds'"}},"required":["username"]}}
